title: Link-State Discovery
description: Each router floods its local link states so every node independently builds the same complete topology map. Link-state discovery converges fast and loop-free, which is why large autonomous networks rely on it.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Shortest-Path Computation
description: Runs Dijkstra over the discovered topology to find minimum-cost paths to every destination. Shortest-path-first routing adapts to link changes automatically: when costs update, paths recompute.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Traffic Engineering
description: Steers flows across the topology to balance load, keeping any single link from saturating while others sit idle. Good traffic engineering squeezes more usable capacity from the same hardware.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Failure Rerouting
description: Detects dead links in milliseconds with hello timeouts and reroutes around them before users notice. Fast reroute precomputes backup paths, so recovery is a local switch rather than a network-wide reconvergence.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Capacity Planning
description: Forecasts traffic growth against topology headroom to schedule upgrades before links saturate. Planning turns capacity from emergency purchases into budgeted, orderly expansion.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Latency Budgets
description: Assigns each service a latency budget and designs topology so critical paths fit within it. Budgets make latency a design input: if the math does not fit, the topology changes before code is written.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Mesh Healing
description: In a mesh topology, nodes automatically discover alternate neighbors when links fail, healing partitions without central control. Healing meshes survive damage that would isolate hierarchical networks.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: SD-WAN Policies
description: Applies centralized policies that steer application traffic across broadband, MPLS, and LTE links by real-time quality. SD-WAN turns dumb transport into application-aware routing without touching the underlay.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: BGP Tuning
description: Tunes BGP attributes - local preference, MED, AS-path prepending - to engineer inbound and outbound traffic across providers. Careful tuning balances cost, performance, and redundancy on internet edges.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Spanning-Tree Optimization
description: Computes loop-free layer-2 topologies with rapid reconvergence, tuning bridge priorities so the root sits optimally. Optimized spanning tree minimizes both convergence time and suboptimal forwarding paths.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Congestion Prediction
description: Forecasts link congestion from traffic patterns and shifts load before queues build, preventing the latency spikes congestion causes. Prediction beats reaction: moving traffic early avoids the packet loss entirely.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Energy-Aware Routing
description: Consolidates traffic onto fewer links during quiet hours so idle equipment can sleep, cutting power without hurting performance. Energy-aware routing treats watts as a routing metric alongside latency and loss.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Topology Simulation
description: Simulates topology changes - new links, failures, policy edits - against a model of the network before touching production. Simulation catches the outages that 'obvious' changes cause, which are the most embarrassing kind.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Change Validation
description: Verifies every planned topology change against policy - no blackholes, no loops, no SLA breaches - before it deploys. Validation is the seatbelt: most changes are fine, but the one that is not can take down the network.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Rollback Snapshots
description: Snapshots the working topology state before each change so rollback is one command that restores exactly the prior forwarding behavior. Snapshots make bold changes safe: the exit is always open.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
